KPlugin.Description: Dark, glass-accented Global Theme for VibeOS — Mauve #cba6f7 accent, layered depth, VibeOS Design System tokens. Forked from Catppuccin Mocha (MIT).
KPlugin.Name: VibeOS Dark

X-VibeOS-Phase: Phase 2 — DELIVERED: this package ships in the image AND is the system default via /etc/xdg/kdeglobals (LookAndFeelPackage=org.vibeos.dark, KConfig cascade, user-overridable). See DESKTOP.md §2.6, §9.
X-VibeOS-Note: KDE reads the authoritative component wiring from contents/defaults, NOT from this file. The map below is documentation only, mirroring contents/defaults so the package is self-describing.

X-VibeOS-Components.widgetStyle: kvantum — Kvantum theme VibeOSDark (desktop/kvantum/VibeOSDark → /usr/share/Kvantum/VibeOSDark). Falls back to Breeze if Kvantum is absent.
X-VibeOS-Components.plasmaTheme: default — Breeze SVG follows the color scheme; the glass panel/dock (glass-chrome) is layered via the Panel Colorizer preset in Phase 2.
X-VibeOS-Components.windowDecoration: org.kde.breeze — VibeOS keeps native window corners/borders (DESKTOP.md §2.5); the radius family applies to surfaces we draw, not KWin frames.
X-VibeOS-Components.iconTheme: breeze-dark — v0.1 default (design system §9); the VibeOS icon set is Phase 5.
X-VibeOS-Components.cursorTheme: breeze_cursors — v0.1 default; the VibeOS cursor set is Phase 5.
X-VibeOS-Components.layout: contents/layouts/org.kde.plasma.desktop-layout.js — slim floating glass top panel + centered auto-hide dock.
